---
title: Obturator Vein
---


# Course

1. Originates from
1. Proximal adductor region @standringGraysAnatomyAnatomical2021
1. Enters the pelvis through the *obturator foramen*
1. Runs postero-superiorly along the lateral pelvic wall
    1. inferior to the *obturator artery* @standringGraysAnatomyAnatomical2021
    1. Between the ureter and internal iliac artery @standringGraysAnatomyAnatomical2021
1. Drains into the *internal iliac vein*

# Variants
Sometimes, the Obturator vein is absent and replaced by an oversized pubic vein that joins the external iliac or the inferior epigastric veins @standringGraysAnatomyAnatomical2021

- FCS PULV-LV
